headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.1-modder.36
summary: The new-version prompt is a small centred card again instead of a full-width slab. A size cap on the wrong side of a fill modifier meant a wide screen stretched the card until the buttons ran edge to edge.

items.text: The prompt that asks whether to update asked for a full-width card before capping its width, so the cap was ignored and the dialog spread across the whole screen on tablets and in landscape. The card is now capped at 340dp, stays centred, and its buttons are inset with rounded corners, so it reads as a normal dialog on both portrait and landscape.
